title: Bittensor Daily News — November 3, 2026
summary: TAO joins Virtune’s AI index basket. Lium and Cascade merge rental fixes, while REAX documents a smaller inference budget.

ecosystem.headline: TAO joins Virtune’s new AI crypto index basket
ecosystem.summary: Virtune’s November 3 issuer announcement includes TAO among 13 equally weighted assets in its physically backed AI Crypto Index ETP. Its stated first trading day is November 3 on Nasdaq Stockholm (VIRAI) and Xetra (VRTI). Quarterly rebalancing and a 1.49% annual management fee apply. This basket is separate from Virtune’s existing single-asset Bittensor ETP. No fund inflows, TAO purchase quantity or price impact were established.
ecosystem.ratingReason: A concrete documented development, with commercial significance and independent execution limited as described.

updates.headline: SN51 Lium merges a check for slow GPU upload links
updates.summary: Lium merged PR1950 on November 3 to add a 10 Mbps upload-speed moving-average floor to VerifyX alongside the download check. A weak uplink can hinder data-heavy rentals even when download speed passes. Missing, NaN, zero and first-unmeasured observations have documented exceptions. The code merge is verified; production rollout was not independently tested.
updates.ratingReason: A concrete documented development, with commercial significance and independent execution limited as described.

updates.headline: SN91 Cascade separates replacement GPU rental clocks
updates.summary: Cascade merged PR421 on November 3 to track spend by individual rent ID rather than a reused pod name. The described failure let a short replacement rental inherit the previous machine’s start time, inflating make-good accounting and triggering a spend cap. The trainer-side fix separates rent records and keeps make-good owed out of the waste-cap pause decision. Merged code does not establish that every running trainer has upgraded.
updates.ratingReason: A concrete documented development, with commercial significance and independent execution limited as described.

updates.headline: SN92 REAX documents a smaller inference reward budget
updates.summary: REAX’s November 2 mining documentation assigns inference 30% of its miner reward budget from the first weight set at or after November 2 at 14:30 UTC, down from 40%. REAX Engine 20% and generalist 30% remain listed; both competitions are paused without a next crowning. Unpaid portions follow the published burn rule. Actual validator application was not reconstructed. These within-miner allocations are separate from the chain’s five-slot eTAO vector.
